dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Perhaps we might consider this mutual influence.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Ratniki become cold, solid, and tough by living alongside these taciturn tables and chairs... while they in turn bear the inevitable rust and tool marks left by time.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Let us pay our respects to those who came before us with a brief moment of silence.
